verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
When the earth is shaken with her violent shaking,
And the earth brings forth her burdens,
And man says, ‘What is the matter with her?’
That day will she tell her news,
[✲]For thy Lord will have revealed about her.

verses.ar: یَوۡمَئِذٍ یَّصۡدُرُ النَّاسُ اَشۡتَاتًا ۬ۙ لِّیُرَوۡا اَعۡمَالَہُمۡ ؕ﴿۷﴾
verses.en: On that day will men come forth in scattered groups that they may be shown the results of their works.
w: that they may be shown the results of

verses.ar: فَمَنۡ یَّعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّۃٍ خَیۡرًا یَّرَہٗ ؕ﴿۸﴾
verses.en: Then whoso does an atom’s weight of good will see it,

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ یَّعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّۃٍ شَرًّا یَّرَہٗ ﴿٪۹﴾
verses.en: And whoso does an atom’s weight of evil will also see it.
